description: Tutorial lesson T4 step 4 ('LET 'EM RIP!') now explains the hit -> wound -> save sequence AND tells the player they can re-order the firing queue with the up/down arrows on the right-hand side, reached with the D-pad. This scenario proves that promise on the SHIPPED pad scheme: boot T4, arm the Boyz (RB) and Confirm Targets (Start), then -- from the dock's primary button where the pad focus lands -- one D-pad UP walks the highlight into the queue's last-row up-arrow, and A actually swaps that weapon up the order. It also asserts the arrows exist on every queue row, that the instructor card carries the new copy, and that focus STAYS in the queue after the swap (ShootingResolutionDock._refocus_move_button) so a player can nudge a weapon more than one slot per trip.

steps.comment: T4 clears boot.auto_assign_single_target, so picking the shooter leaves every gun unaimed: the lesson now has the player aim them (steps 'aim_first_gun' / 'aim_da_rest') before Confirm. This scenario is about the dock's firing-order arrows, so it just walks the same pad aiming path to get three weapons queued.

D-pad parks the virtual cursor (VirtualCursor._input park() on any D-pad press). The picker/Continue glides above left it live, and PadRouter._assign_highlighted_target bails while the cursor owns A. Only one target is eligible, so the ring does not move.
